name: Model-Optimizer
description: A unified library of SOTA model optimization techniques like quantization, distillation, pruning, neural architecture search, speculative decoding, etc. It compresses deep learning models for downstream deployment frameworks like TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, etc. to optimize inference speed.
one_liner: A toolbox that shrinks and speeds up AI models so they run cheaper and faster on real servers, without needing to retrain them from scratch.
buyer: An ML infrastructure lead at a company with a real AI product whose monthly GPU inference bill is too high and needs it cut without hurting quality.
business_use_cases: An AI startup uses it to cut inference costs on their production model before a funding round scrutinizes burn rate.
An MLOps consultancy offers a 'cut your inference bill by 30%' audit service built around this toolkit.
A hardware-constrained edge-AI company (e.g. on-device features) uses it to fit a model onto cheaper hardware.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid 'model optimization audits' for companies with expensive inference bills.
Retainer-based ongoing model optimization as a company's models evolve.

steal_this: Pick one open-source model, optimize it with this toolkit this weekend, and pitch the before/after cost numbers to a startup you know is burning money on inference.
